title: Understanding the Business Problem
scenario:
Your manager tells you:
"Our repeat purchases have decreased during the last six months. We want to understand which customers are likely to stop purchasing and why."
question: What should you do first?
choice_a: Clarify what "churn" means for the business, define the analysis objective and identify what decisions the company wants to make from the results.
choice_b: Start exploring the customer dataset immediately.
choice_c: Immediately build a prediction model.
why: "Churn" must have a clear business definition. For example, the company may define a customer as churned if they have not purchased for 90 days.
a_feedback: 🌟 Excellent decision! "Churn" must have a clear business definition. For example, the company may define a customer as churned if they have not purchased for 90 days.
b_feedback: 👍 Good decision, but incomplete. You chose a valid path but missed the best approach.
c_feedback: ⚠️ Needs Improvement. This choice introduces unnecessary risk or technical debt.
